name: Felodipine

examples.title: Hypertension in Hemodialysis Patients (Aim 3)
examples.why: Stopped by data safety monitoring board

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Felodipine has a high risk score of 71 for the liver and a low risk score of 28 for the heart [M]. In human research, a search found four records with one trial focusing on high blood pressure in patients receiving hemodialysis, which is a treatment to filter waste from the blood [4][5]. That specific study was stopped early by an independent safety monitoring board [5].
